claims.name: DefectIntertwiner
claims.source: docs/c4-lowest-defect-intertwiner.md

lean_support.note: Lean proves Q_r S = Phi_r Q_r on normalised representatives for r = 2 (M (x) M on any finite alphabet; Lambda^2 M in wedge coordinates over Fin 3) and r = 3 (M^{(x)3}), assuming the lower defects vanish on every state, and that over Fin 3 the K_3 columns lie in Lie_3 (Ree at degree three on three letters, explicit Lyndon basis), which M^{(x)3} preserves. Also the weights of Phi_3 on Lie_3 for diagonalizable M (charpoly_phi3Lie), and (Psc.SectorBridge) the diagonalization of M from three distinct roots of chi_M (e.g. chi_M irreducible), Q_3 S = Phi_3 Q_3 into Lie_3, q_3 = chi(Phi_3 | im Q_3) dividing chi_S and chi(Phi_3), and every root of q_3 a root of chi_S and a weight of shape (2,1,0) or (1,1,1). Not formalized: the first-defect selection and thm:deg23 (iii) itself (it also needs rho(S) <= beta as a bound on the roots of chi_S and semisimplicity of Phi_3 on im Q_3). Psc.Degree3Sector proves thm:deg23 (iii) on representatives: every root of chi(Phi_3 | im Q_3) is det M, im Q_3 lies in ker(Phi_3 - det M) over Q and rank Q_3 <= 2, given chi_M irreducible with two roots of modulus < 1 and the root bound of prop:cocycle (discharged for primitive sigma). Reductio lemmas; the only full control is degenerate. Psc.StrictSystem restates thm:deg23 (iii) on a strict system or component of first defect degree 3 over Fin 3 (StrictSystem.deg23_iii: given only M primitive, chi_M irreducible and a Pisot root; every structural hypothesis, including the first-defect selection, discharged), with the exclusion form no_strictSystem_deg3_of_not_eigen; Psc.Degree3Sector.finrank_ker_sub_det_eq_two gives dim_Q ker(Phi_3 - det M) = 2. No control meets the strict-system hypotheses; on 011/2/120 there is no strict system at all (Psc.StrictSystem.census_vacuous).

claims.name: Degree4Floor
claims.source: docs/c4-degree4-free-lie.md

lean_support.note: Lean proves the degree-4 first-defect intertwiner inputs: for 3-binomially equivalent states K_4(sigma u, sigma v) = M^{(x)4} K_4(u, v), Q_4 S = M^{(x)4} Q_4 on representatives, K_4 in Lie_4 over Fin 3 and Q_4 S = Phi_4 Q_4 with Phi_4 = M^{(x)4}|Lie_4, and the characteristic polynomial of the rational Phi_4 for diagonalizable M (Witt multiplicities 1, 1, 3 at shapes (3,1,0), (2,2,0), (2,1,1); 0 at (4,0,0)). Also (Psc.SectorBridge): the diagonalization of M from irreducibility of chi_M, q_4 = chi(Phi_4 | im Q_4) dividing chi_S and chi(Phi_4), and every root of q_4 a root of chi_S and a weight of shape (3,1,0), (2,2,0) or (2,1,1), which are the hypotheses habc, hq of the Psc.GaloisOrbit shape theorems for q = q_4 (galoisOrbit_input_q4, given any three distinct roots of chi_M; non-vacuity on the 3-cycle relabelling, chi_M = X^3 - 1). Not formalized: the first-defect selection, and the composition with the weight eliminations of Psc.GaloisOrbit (which also needs chi_M irreducible, the Pisot moduli, 1 <= |det M|, and rho(S) <= beta as a bound on the roots of chi_S). Psc.Degree4Floor composes these with the Galois-orbit eliminations: with chi_M irreducible, a Pisot root beta, 3-binomially equivalent states, a nonzero K_4 column and the root bound of prop:cocycle (discharged for primitive sigma), |det M| = 1 and chi_S has a root of modulus |beta|; with N_C strongly connected, (2,2,0) is excluded and S = d D N_C D (gauge or anti-gauge). Reductio lemmas: no control meets every hypothesis. Psc.StrictSystem restates them on a strict system or component of first defect degree 4 over Fin 3 (StrictSystem.sieve4, StrictComponent.theoremA, StrictComponent.gauge_or_antiGauge: given only M primitive, chi_M irreducible and a Pisot root), with the exclusion forms no_strictSystem_deg4_of_abs_det_ne_one and no_strictComponent_deg4_of_hasBothSigns; m0_no_degree4 excludes every r = 4 normalised child system over the det = -2 substitution m0Subst. Theorem A(ii) is proved in eigenvalue form only and Theorem A(iv) is not composed with Q_4 D.
